SILO synthetic capacity policy
Usable capacity is quantity multiplied by capacity_kg per item, summed across eligible rows.
Only inventory with status eligible contributes to usable capacity.
Retired and quarantined inventory must be excluded and reported separately.
Quantities must be nonnegative integers; capacities must be present, finite, and nonnegative.
Malformed rows must produce an error rather than a guessed value.
All examples are fictional and use kilograms (kg).
